siteDefaults.title: Site Policy Defaults
siteDefaults.hint: Applied to every new site you create - these are policy decisions that are almost always the same across an organization, not a real per-site attribute. Any existing site keeps its own saved value; you can still override any of these for a specific site from that site's own Edit form.

breakRoundingMode.full_hour: Rounds up to a full hour

siteDefaults.invalidGpsTolerance: Enter a GPS accuracy tolerance greater than zero.
siteDefaults.genericError: Unable to update the site defaults.

sitePolicy.title: Site rules
sitePolicy.hint: This site's GPS tolerance, grace period, shift times, overtime and late deduction, break rounding, presence monitoring, exempt employees and self-service blocks.
sitePolicy.noSites: No sites yet - add one from Sites first.
sitePolicy.loadError: Unable to load this site's policy.
sitePolicy.noAssignmentsYet: No one is assigned to this site yet, so there's no one to exempt.
sitePolicy.genericError: Unable to update this site's policy.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.hint: Read-only keys let another system - an ERP, accounting, HR or reporting tool - read your data through the PROSM Time API. Give each key only the scopes it needs. A key can never change anything in PROSM Time.
integrations.createError: Unable to create this API key.
integrations.revokeError: Unable to revoke this API key.
integrations.newKeyWarning: Copy this now - it will not be shown again. Only its prefix is kept afterward.
integrations.revokeWarning: "{{name}}" stops working immediately and cannot be restored. The system using it will need a new key.

payroll.title: Payroll Integration
payroll.notConfigured: This integration isn't set up yet - ask your administrator to add its API credentials.

rejectMockLocation.label: Reject clock in/out from a fake location
rejectMockLocation.hint: Android reports when a location comes from a mock-location (fake GPS) app. Off: it is recorded and sent to managers for review. On: the clock in or out is refused.

sessionPolicy.title: Shifts left open
sessionPolicy.hint: Nothing closes at the end of a shift. After the first number of hours the employee is asked "still working?" and the managers are told once; after the second the shift is closed automatically and its hours wait for a manager's review.
sessionPolicy.invalid: The alert must come before the close (1 to 72 hours).

overtimePolicy.title: Overtime and deductions
overtimePolicy.hint: For the whole organisation. Blank = the default. Multipliers apply on top of the overtime-hour price; 1 keeps today's amounts.

field.roundMinutes: Round each day's worked time to (minutes)

overtimePolicy.alertLabel: Overtime alert (minutes after the shift ends)
overtimePolicy.alertHint: You are told when someone is still clocked in this many minutes after their shift ends. 15 by default; a negative number warns before the end.

leaveTypes.title: Leave types
leaveTypes.hint: Changes apply to coming entitlements; balances already set are kept.
leaveTypes.name: Name
leaveTypes.enforceBalance: Refuse a request beyond the balance
leaveTypes.maxTimesInService: Maximum times in the whole service
leaveTypes.invalidTiers: Write the tiers as years:days separated by commas.

plan.title: Plan
plan.redeemFailed: The code is wrong or already used.
plan.always: In every plan: clocking at the site, the work area, the photo, working offline, the map, basic reports and 9 languages.

features.on_behalf: Clocking on behalf of an employee
features.scheduling: Shift scheduling, open shifts and swaps
features.manager_alerts: Manager alerts (missed shift, overtime, morning summary)

plan.managedByProsm: Any change or renewal of your licence is made by PROSM; you get a notification and an email with the new licence. To change it, write to sales@prosm.net.
plan.historyAll: Attendance records shown: all of them. Location points and photos are deleted automatically after the period in “Data retention”.
plan.history_one: Attendance records shown and reported: the last year. Older records are kept and come back with a higher plan. Location points and photos are deleted automatically after the period in “Data retention”.
plan.history_other: Attendance records shown and reported: the last {{count}} years. Older records are kept and come back with a higher plan. Location points and photos are deleted automatically after the period in “Data retention”.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.subtitle: You can only shorten these. A shorter period also applies to stored data, and anything older is deleted automatically.

clockSuggestion.title: Ask when the app opens inside a site
clockSuggestion.subtitle: When someone opens the app inside a site, it asks whether to clock in. Nothing is recorded without their answer, the ordinary clock-in follows, and no background location is used.
clockSuggestion.label: Ask the person to clock in

calendar.title: Work calendar
calendar.hint: Public holidays, weekly rest days and exceptional days.

payroll.title: Payroll settings
payroll.hint: Components, proration, cycle periods, reports, publishing and export.

externalPolicy.title: External labour pay policy
externalPolicy.hint: Deductions and additions, and the day-rate rule for monthly and yearly rates.

permissions.title: Grant permissions and delegation
permissions.hint: Give a person the owner's authority - all of it or chosen permissions, for a period.

auditLog.title: Action log
auditLog.hint: Who did what and when, with the reason.
